# Design System Inspired by a night shift console

## Color Palette & Roles

- **Console Black** (`#0d1013`): Page background, the deepest surface
- **Panel** (`#161b20`): Cards, containers, elevated surfaces
- **Signal Teal** (`#2bb3a3`): Primary brand accent — buttons, focus, active states
- **Chalk** (`#e8ecef`): Primary text and headings
- **Fog** (`#a3adb6`): Secondary text, captions
- **Seam** (`#2a3138`): Borders and divider lines
- **Go Green** (`#3fb86b`): Success states
- **Alarm** (`#f06a5f`): Error and destructive states
